text:
ITEM 1 | Sliced pale tan-beige meat portion, about 12 cm long by 7 cm wide, two overlapping slices stacked on one side of the plate, with slightly browned, golden-brown edges and a smooth, firm, moist-looking cut face showing fine grain; sits on the upper left of the plate beside the rice | 150

ITEM 2 | Irregular wedge-shaped portion about 9 cm by 6 cm, bright orange-red and golden surface with dark green leafy pieces mixed through, appearing soft, slightly moist and layered, with browned crispy edges and a few flecks of white; sits on the upper right of the plate next to the sliced meat | 90

ITEM 3 | Mound of loose white cooked grains, about 9 cm by 8 cm footprint and roughly 2.5 cm tall, separate fluffy grains with slight sheen and no visible sauce, crumbly and not holding a firm shape; sits on the lower left of the plate | 130
